title: Tenzing's family in Meghalaya
body: Tenzing lives with his parents and grandparents in a village in the mountains of Meghalaya. His father runs a small grocery store. When his mother became busy in a local handicraft cooperative that makes traditional fabrics and wood carvings for tourists, his father began cleaning the house, looking after their small vegetable garden and doing other chores, and he often helps Tenzing's grandmother cook for the family. The grandmother tells Tenzing stories full of humour and wisdom. His grandfather helps him with homework, takes him to the school bus stop and does social work in the colony: he reports power failures at the nearby office and once collected money from the neighbourhood to repair a neighbour's house damaged in a storm. Tenzing's parents discuss any special expenses together, and his mother says the family should always save some money for unexpected needs in the future.
